_description: Ad platforms that cannot be bought in a market because the market's government blocks them. Read by publisher_filter.platform_blocked_in / platform_runs_in, so every plan surface (workbook, deck, Nova tools) drops the platform for a plan whose markets are all blocked. Kept apart from publisher_availability.json on purpose: that file's dates describe the Joveo supply network, and a government block is not a supply-network change. Every entry carries a source and the date it was checked.

blocks.name: TikTok
blocks.reason: TikTok has been blocked in India since 29 June 2020; ads cannot be bought there.
